hook.en: A farmer in Kedah grows padi, a factory in Penang makes microchips, and a tour guide in Langkawi shows visitors around. All three are part of Malaysia's economy.
hook.bm: Seorang petani di Kedah menanam padi, kilang di Pulau Pinang menghasilkan cip mikro dan pemandu pelancong di Langkawi membawa pelawat bersiar-siar. Ketiga-tiganya sebahagian ekonomi Malaysia.

bigIdeas.en: Primary activities take resources from nature; secondary activities process them in factories; tertiary activities provide services.
bigIdeas.bm: Kegiatan primer mengambil sumber daripada alam; kegiatan sekunder memprosesnya di kilang; kegiatan tertier menyediakan perkhidmatan.

bigIdeas.en: Activities are spread according to physical and human factors.
bigIdeas.bm: Kegiatan ekonomi tertabur mengikut faktor fizikal dan manusia.

bigIdeas.en: Economic activities bring income, jobs, foreign exchange and development.
bigIdeas.bm: Kegiatan ekonomi membawa pendapatan, pekerjaan, pertukaran wang asing dan pembangunan.

cells.en: Padi (MADA, Kedah/Perlis), oil palm, rubber, fishing, mining, logging
cells.bm: Padi (MADA, Kedah/Perlis), kelapa sawit, getah, perikanan, perlombongan, pembalakan
Elektronik (Pulau Pinang), kereta, penapisan minyak sawit

definition.en: Obtaining raw materials directly from nature.
definition.bm: Mendapatkan bahan mentah terus daripada alam.

definition.en: Providing services to people and businesses.
definition.bm: Menyediakan perkhidmatan kepada orang ramai dan perniagaan.

definition.en: A major padi-growing area, e.g. MADA in Kedah and Perlis.
definition.bm: Kawasan utama penanaman padi, cth. MADA di Kedah dan Perlis.

definition.en: An area with tax benefits for export industries, e.g. Bayan Lepas.
definition.bm: Kawasan dengan faedah cukai untuk industri eksport, cth. Bayan Lepas.

question.en: Classify: tapping rubber, making rubber gloves, selling gloves online.
question.bm: Kelaskan: menoreh getah, membuat sarung tangan getah, menjual sarung tangan dalam talian.

steps.en: Tapping rubber takes latex from trees → primary.
steps.bm: Menoreh getah mengambil susu getah daripada pokok → primer.

steps.en: Making gloves in a factory → secondary.
steps.bm: Membuat sarung tangan di kilang → sekunder.

steps.en: Selling online is a service → tertiary.
steps.bm: Menjual dalam talian ialah perkhidmatan → tertier.
